edit.description: The read verb's embedded corpus takes ONE of its two contributors: `:2456` calls the lock-only `compose::embedded_features_by_kind`, so `by_kind` — the member-existence oracle `resolve` (:217, doc :205-:212) reads, and the corpus `why`/`impact`/`context` walk — holds the lock's `nested_member` rows and not one member a host's own read composed. Both maps the fix needs are already in hand: `builtin_units_and_features` (:2393) and `custom_units_and_features` (pushed at :2454), each carrying `compose::KindUnitsAndFeatures::composed_embedded` (`compose.rs`:528, `ComposedEmbeddedMember` pub at :501). The change is the three lines `gate.rs`:447-453 already spells — flat_map both, call `embedded_features_by_kind_with_composed` — which is also why it belongs here rather than in a helper: the assembly at `:2457` is the read's own. Stale prose rides the edit: `narrate_hosted_kinds`' doc (:1054-:1062) calls the fallback corpus's embedded entries "the lock's `nested_member` rows lifted leaf-by-leaf into fields", true of one contributor only. The lock-only arity stays — nine callers with no manifest corpus keep it earned.

The end-to-end arm over the real binary through `common::explain_in` (already used three times here): a harness whose `.claude/settings.json` carries a hook matcher group with a handler narrates that handler's own member address (`hook:<Event>/handler/0`) rather than answering "No member named ... is in the surface" three times over. The vacuity pin is the check side of the same fixture — `coverage.checked` disclosing `handler (1 embedded)` (or the composed set asserted non-empty) before the narration is judged, per `engineering.md`, "A green verdict is proven non-vacuous".

summary: `explain` ranges over the same embedded corpus the gate does, so a composed handler member narrates instead of reading as absent.
